segments.comment: A second Big Room level teleport, on a seed whose rnd(13) variant is bigrm-2: it darkens a union of relative selections through region(selection, "unlit") and, on a percent(25) roll, replaces floor inside that selection's grown copy through des.replace_terrain({ selection }), which is how l_selection_check() shifts a relative selection into the map frame before lspo_region and lspo_replace_terrain paint it. Seeds 7306-7335 were replayed with the port to read each seed's variant; 7314 is the first bigrm-2. See bigroom-level-teleport for the level menu.
